The Institutional Edition: recorded in the deployment profile (setup, afterwards proposed citing the law and confirmed by a different official through policy-change.ts; none ships); it names the institutions and modules it runs, and the registers and procedures follow from them; a procedure of an institution outside it opens no case, an exchange service another institution owns answers "not connected" (503, a receipt, no answer field), a step that needs another register (an education-register qualification) pauses with the reason

The portable export: one institution's registers, procedures, cases, sealed decisions (never re-sealed), documents and its audit-chain and access-log segments (other institutions' entries only as links: sequence and hashes) with the trust list, sealed through key custody like a backup, proposed by its administrator and confirmed by a different official who can sign there (never set going from whole-government scope for an independent institution), in the audit chain and the access log; re-imported into an empty installation by two administrators with every record identifier unchanged; verified offline (scripts/verify-institution-export.mjs runs the platform's own audit, access-log, seal and trust-list checks with no server)

The pilot exit gate (S6-I-11), computed from the records each time, never a status field: approved procedures in force, completed cases that are not samples per procedure, sealed decisions verifying against approved (never sample) seal keys, decisions under a mapping in force, the audit chain verifying, access-log reads of each case, the signed-in officials who acted; not met in a demonstration, with exactly what is missing; on the onboarding hub (track pilot) and the health regulation console (Pilot exit gate tab)

missing: The gate met in a production installation with the nation's own records: a deployment act (authorised officials completing real cases), never shipped or set by the platform
Certificates, recall-notice deliveries and capacity returns of organisations outside the institution's registers are not yet in the export (integration register 20.43)
Export and import are tested in memory; the file, supabase and postgres state modes are not yet exercised by a test (integration register 20.42)
Choosing the pilot (S6-I-14 to S6-I-21) and appeals run end to end (S2-B-03, S6-K-15) stay with their own rows
access: Export: proposed by an administrator of the institution, confirmed by a different official who can sign there; download by its administrators and signatories, logged as an export
Import: two administrators serving the whole government
Exit gate: administrators, auditors, the pilot institutions' officials and the whole government (read only)
provenance: Record identity unchanged when federating later: an import keeps every id, reference and number and the evidence the decisions verify against
Decisions are never re-sealed; documents are sealed again under the new installation's key only after each version's SHA-256 is checked

existing.name: runs facility licensing, professional registration and the medicines register end to end with no other institution present
degrades explicitly: a service another institution owns answers "not connected", and a step that needs another register pauses
is recorded in setup and names its institutions, modules, registers and procedures; nothing outside it runs
changes after setup only through the change process: cited, confirmed by a different official, every version kept
carries the institution's own records and nothing of another's, sealed, and verifies with no running server
is proposed by an administrator of the institution and confirmed by a different official who can sign there; never from whole-government scope for an independent institution
goes back into an empty installation with every record identifier unchanged, and verifies there

forms_without_procedure.title: Apply to establish a health facility
forms_without_procedure.stage: An establishment-approval procedure of the health regulator on the health-facilities register, before the licence application (health.facility): not built; the form waits in the library (plan step I4).

forms_without_procedure.title: Submit a corrective action plan for a health facility
forms_without_procedure.stage: Follow-up of an inspection (health.facility inspection stage, and inspections of licensed facilities): a corrective-action follow-up procedure is not built; the form waits in the library (plan step I4).

forms_without_procedure.title: Apply to vary a health facility's services or capacity
forms_without_procedure.stage: A variation of a standing in the health-facilities register (assessment, then a decision under the approved permit mapping): not built; the form waits in the library (plan step I4).

forms_without_procedure.title: Tell the regulator a health facility is closing
forms_without_procedure.stage: Closure or surrender of a standing in the health-facilities register (lib/organisations/procedures.ts effects): not built; the form waits in the library (plan step I4).

forms_without_procedure.title: Report a concern about a health facility
forms_without_procedure.stage: A complaint intake of the health regulator that registers the concern and refers it (lib/casework/referral.ts) or opens grounds for a review (health.facility-suspension, document "grounds"): the intake is not built; the form waits in the library (plan step I4).

forms_without_procedure.title: Check a health facility's licence
forms_without_procedure.stage: Answered by the public check (/registers) and the organisation.standing exchange service; no case is opened.

forms_without_procedure.title: Apply to change your registration category or scope
forms_without_procedure.stage: An amendment of a professional's standing (category, scope, conditions) on the professions register: not built (prof.renewal can change conditions only at renewal); the form waits in the library (plan step I4).

forms_without_procedure.title: Ask for a certificate of good standing
forms_without_procedure.stage: A good-standing certificate procedure of the professions register (entitlement check, then a certificate issued from the register, lib/records/certificates.ts): not built (prof.registration issues only the registration certificate); the form waits in the library (plan step I4).

forms_without_procedure.title: Complain about a health professional
forms_without_procedure.stage: A conduct-complaint intake of the professions regulator that registers and routes the complaint: to a conduct investigation (HLT-LIC-009) and fitness-to-practise case (prof.fitness, document "grounds") or by referral to another institution (lib/casework/referral.ts); the intake is not built; the form waits in the library (plan step I4).

forms_without_procedure.title: Review an interim restriction on a professional
forms_without_procedure.stage: An interim-restriction review of the professions register, only once the nation's law provides interim restrictions and the permit authority registry maps the power: not built; the form waits in the library (plan step I4).

forms_without_procedure.title: Check a health professional's registration
forms_without_procedure.stage: Answered by the public check (/api/registers/professionals) and the professional.standing exchange service; no case is opened.

forms_without_procedure.title: Check a medicine's or device's authorisation
forms_without_procedure.stage: Answered by the public product check (/api/health-regulation/products, publicProductView()) and the product.status exchange service, called only by integrations two officials approve for a purpose; no case is opened.

forms_without_procedure.title: Submit an aggregate public-health return
forms_without_procedure.stage: A public-health aggregate return of the receiving authority, kept like the capacity returns (lib/health/register.ts: versioned, always marked reported, corrections as new versions): the programme returns are not built; the form waits in the library (plan step I4).
